caption: Matching the patterns of adjacent tiles
content: When you place a tile, you need to @b{match the pattern} on every adjacent side of the surrounding tiles.
See the cell @m{pending}. You can place @t{forest_road.2s.lr} or @t{forest_road.2t.ur}, but you can place neither @t{forest_road.2t.ul} nor @t{forest_road.2t.dr}.
As the game progresses, terrains other than the road @t{forest_road.2s.lr} may appear. All of them must follow the rule: match the pattern.
